meta.name: gaai-oss-discover
meta.description: Activate the GAAI OSS Discovery Agent to clarify intent and produce governed artefacts such as PRDs, Epics, Stories, and decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清需求意图，生成产品文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责产品规划与需求分析
copy.tagline_en: Clarify intent and produce product documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for product planning and requirements analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会读取项目中的GAAI配置和规则文件，然后引导你澄清产品意图，并生成或更新受治理的工件，如PRD、Epics和用户故事。
howto.when: 当你想定义要构建什么、细化范围、创建或更新backlog项、评估产品转向或回答产品策略问题时，会触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我写出这个新功能的PRD。
我们现有的Epic需要更新，帮我修改。
这个产品方向对吗？帮我评估一下。
say.note: Claude会进行发现工作以评估转向。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reads GAAI configuration and rules from the project, then guides you to clarify product intent and produce or update governed artifacts like PRDs, Epics, and user stories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to define what to build, refine scope, create/update backlog items, evaluate a pivot, or answer product strategy questions.

say_en.text: Help me write a PRD for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude starts the Discovery flow and generates a PRD.

say_en.text: Our existing Epic needs updating; please revise it.
say_en.note: Claude reads the existing Epic and updates it.

say_en.text: Is this product direction correct? Evaluate it.
say_en.note: Claude performs discovery work to assess the pivot.
